detail.q: What key do I press to sell on credit?
detail.answer: To sell on credit first choose the customer with F6, then charge with F4 credit. [D03] The system does not let a sale go over the customer's credit limit. [D03] Lists each customer, the current balance, the credit limit and the days since the last payment. [D16]

detail.q: What is the maximum credit limit for a customer?
detail.answer: The maximum limit is 1500 pesos. [D44] Lists each customer, the current balance, the credit limit and the days since the last payment. [D16] The system does not let a sale go over the customer's credit limit. [D03]

detail.q: What is the maximum cash allowed in the drawer?
detail.answer: The cash in the drawer must not exceed 3000 pesos, the excess is withdrawn with F8 option 1 and authorized by the manager. [D41] Every day the owner or the manager reviews Panel then Exceptions: cancellations, removed items, discounts and drawer opened without a sale. [D102] At shift change the leaving cashier does the partial cut and counts the drawer with the next cashier. [D99]

detail.q: How long do customers have to return a product?
detail.answer: Return of a product by a customer. [D27] Customers can return products within 24 hours with their ticket. [D46] Customer returned a milk carton expired yesterday. [D76]

detail.q: At what temperature must meat be kept?
detail.answer: Meat is kept below 4 degrees Celsius and the refrigerator temperature is recorded twice a day. [D45] Meat and dairy must stay below 4 degrees. [D95] Received 2 beef quarters, 118 kg total, temperature 3 degrees. [D85]

detail.q: What time does the store open?
detail.answer: Rules for opening and closing the store. [D48] The store opens at 7 am and closes at 10 pm. [D48] The server is inside the store and the registers connect through the local network. [D50]

detail.q: How long are old backups kept?
detail.answer: Old backups are kept for 30 days. [D47] Every month check the date of the last backup and do a restore test on another computer: a backup that was never restored does not count. [D10] The backup key was shown only once during installation; keep it written on paper outside the store. [D10]

detail.q: Which key opens the cashier menu for the cash cut?
detail.answer: Open the register menu with F8 and choose option 5, cash cut. [D04] The shift closes and the register is free for the next cashier. [D04] Choose your name with the arrow keys and Enter, type your 6 digit PIN, then count the opening cash fund in the drawer and type it. [D01]

detail.q: What happens after several failed PIN attempts?
detail.answer: After 5 wrong PIN attempts the user is locked for 15 minutes or until the owner unlocks it. [D43] When you finish press Back to register; the cashier logs in again with their PIN and the ticket in progress is still there. [D101] If the printer fails the sale is saved anyway, reprint it with F7. [D09]

detail.q: What percentage of the beef quarter is sellable meat?
detail.answer: The beef quarter yielded 72 percent sellable meat, 18 percent bones and fat and 10 percent loss. [D67] The 45 kg quarter produced steak, ground beef, ribs and bones. [D34] Stock of beef quarter increased in the system. [D85]
Suppliers are paid by transfer on Fridays. [D92] Cash payments to suppliers are not allowed above 2,000 pesos. [D92] Sale paid with mixed payment. [D26]

detail.q: What is the minimum margin for a promotion?
detail.answer: Each promotion needs start and end dates and a minimum margin of 8 percent. [D94] Sale price is calculated from the cost plus a minimum margin by department. [D49] Monthly report with revenue, cost of goods sold and gross margin by department. [D12]

detail.q: How do I charge a card if there is no internet?
detail.answer: How to charge with card using the Point terminal of your register. [D08] If there is no internet use charge manually: charge on the terminal and type the authorization number. [D08] The card payment was declined by the terminal. [D77]

detail.q: Until when can a customer ask for an invoice?
detail.answer: Customers can ask for an invoice within the same month of the purchase. [D96] Request from a customer to receive an electronic invoice for the purchase on ticket 000930. [D23] Global invoice of the month for sales without individual invoice. [D78]

detail.q: Which products are on the low stock list?
detail.answer: List of products below the minimum stock level. [D35] For each product it shows current stock, minimum level and suggested quantity to buy. [D35] When stock falls below the minimum the system adds the product to the low stock alert. [D84]

detail.q: How do I open the manager panel from the register?
detail.answer: In the register press F9, choose your name and type your PIN: the manager panel opens. [D101] If the panel is not used for 5 minutes it returns to the register by itself. [D101] Open the admin, go to Users and add one user per person with the role cashier, butcher or manager. [D53]

detail.q: How do I reprint a ticket?
detail.answer: If the customer asks for a copy press F7 shift sales, select the ticket and choose reprint. [D56] The reprint is recorded. [D56] The ticket shows the authorization number and the last four digits of the card. [D22]
